title: ever DIONE|Gorgeous V Neck Leaf-Sequined Fishtail Party Dress
descriptionHtml:
Want to look like a princess from a fairy tale? If yes, then this sequin party dress would surely make you look like one. It has a fishtail silhouette and beautiful ruffles sleeves. This Christmas party dress features a plunging v-neckline and a belt for the waistline. Wear this party dress and make every woman jealous. We think this gorgeous party dress is perfect for all formal occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming and graduation!


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is concealed Zipper up the Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, without Lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
